title: The Labyrinth
description: Areteon and Dolosa enter a deadly labyrinth in pursuit of glory and freedom, but escaping its final challenge may demand a sacrifice neither expected.
excerpt: Areteon and Dolosa enter a towering labyrinth filled with beasts and deadly obstacles. When the exit finally comes into sight, only one question remains: what are they willing to sacrifice to escape?
